headline: SDP @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.61 at MIL 4.14, with a projected total of 7.75. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved -0.21 runs while MIL moved -0.40, changing the projected margin by +0.19 runs. The projected total fell -0.61, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Kyle Harrison has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Jake Bauers, Brice Turang, William Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ramón Laureano, Manny Machado because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
